headline: Ex-Addl IGP Iqbal Bahar and 2 others shown arrested in murder case
summary: A Dhaka court has ordered the arrest of former MP Harunur Rashid, ex-Additional IGP Iqbal Bahar, and Awami League leader Kazi Monirul Islam in the Emon Gazi murder case.
details: A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate's court has ordered three high-profile individuals to be shown arrested in connection with the murder of Emon Gazi.

// The individuals include former MP Harunur Rashid, former Additional Inspector General of Police (Additional IGP) Iqbal Bahar, and Kazi Monirul Islam, the president of the Jatrabari Thana Awami League.
caption:
Former MP Harunur Rashid and ex-Additional IGP Iqbal Bahar are among three high-profile figures ordered to be shown arrested in a murder case.

A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate's court has ordered three high-profile individuals to be shown arrested in connection with the murder of Emon Gazi.

headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman [[assures job for mother of July martyr]]
headline: PM Tarique Rahman assures job for mother of July martyr
summary: Fatema Tuz Zohra, who lost her son and husband, met the Prime Minister at the National Parliament Secretariat's PM office.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman met with Fatema Tuz Zohra, the mother of Abdullah Bin Zahid, who was killed during the July uprising. Fatema brought along her younger son, Mahmudullah Bin Zishan, who is battling cancer.
During the meeting, the Prime Minister inquired about Zishan's health and assured Fatema Tuz Zohra of a job to support her family.
The family's tragedy began on August 5, 2024, when Abdullah Bin Zahid was shot dead. Two weeks later, the younger son, Mahmudullah Bin Zishan, was diagnosed with cancer.
Fatema Tuz Zohra also lost her husband seven months later, leaving her alone to bear the costs of her cancer treatment for her remaining son.
The Prime Minister, while serving as the Acting Chairman of BNP, had previously provided support for Zishan's cancer treatment through Atiqur Rahman, the current Additional Press Secretary to the PM.
The medical management of Zishan's treatment continues to be overseen by the Prime Minister under his personal supervision.
caption:
A mother who lost her son and husband is now receiving support from the Prime Minister.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman met with Fatema Tuz Zohra, the mother of Abdullah Bin Zahid, who was killed during the July uprising. Fatema brought along her younger son, Mahmudullah Bin Zishan, who is battling cancer.

During the meeting, the Prime Minister inquired about Zishan's health and assured Fatema Tuz Zohra of a job to support her family.

The family's tragedy began on August 5, 2024, when Abdullah Bin Zahid was shot dead. Two weeks later, the younger son, Mahmudullah Bin Zishan, was diagnosed with cancer.

Fatema Tuz Zohra also lost her husband seven months later, leaving her alone to bear the costs of her cancer treatment for her remaining son.

The Prime Minister, while serving as the Acting Chairman of BNP, had previously provided support for Zishan's cancer treatment through Atiqur Rahman, the current Additional Press Secretary to the PM.

The medical management of Zishan's treatment continues to be overseen by the Prime Minister under his personal supervision.

#Bangladesh #TariqueRahman #JulyUprising #HumanInterest #News

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star
